TRANSPORT GROUP CALL FOR OIL ROLLBACKS, TAX SUSPENSIONS

Transport group Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Operator Nationwide (PISTON) holds a nationwide transport strike at Welcome Rotonda, Quezon City, on March 19 to protest rising oil costs. 

According to PISTON president Mody Floranda, the group calls for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to remove value-added and excise taxes for fuel. 

📷: The STAR/Edd Gumban
